intent_en: To illustrate how sales performance can start strong with an initial peak but decline significantly over time.
previous_intent: To illustrate the trend of sales starting high and then declining significantly over time, leading to sustained low performance.
narration_support: You might make half your salary on the first day, but by the 20th or 50th, things don't look so good.
chart_support: Line chart plotting Sales against Time, displaying a high initial peak labeled 'Wow' followed by a downward trend labeled 'Not bad' and 'Yikes'.
evidence_note: The narration describes a front-loaded income pattern (high early, low later), which matches the chart's depiction of Sales peaking early on Time and then dropping.
